Meet EgoGaze. Record what a person sees, alongside where their eyes are directed. A small data collection tool for future robot learning.
Start recording. This simulator follows attention across a synthetic tabletop. Raw frames and gaze samples are stored separately, with host timestamps and visible timing metrics.
Stop, then replay the session. Export a ZIP with images, gaze records, and a quality manifest. Missing gaze stays missing, and poor time matches are flagged.
Real recordings preserve the SDK gaze coordinates. Scene camera projection requires calibration. This is an inspectable collection prototype, with hardware validation and robot training still ahead.
